V0_verification.rule: every verify run reproduces the release margins within the nats thresholds and agrees on correctness for at least the threshold fraction of items

R1_pythia_replicates_margin.rule: nine-seed PolyPythias at one matched step, jackknife lower endpoint above one

R1_pythia_replicates_accuracy.rule: nine-seed PolyPythias at one matched step, jackknife lower endpoint above one

R2_pythia_identification_margin.rule: cross-bank interval above one and the within-minus-cross difference including zero rejects the item explanation; a positive difference interval with a cross-bank interval covering one supports it

R2_pythia_identification_accuracy.rule: cross-bank interval above one and the within-minus-cross difference including zero rejects the item explanation; a positive difference interval with a cross-bank interval covering one supports it
